decisions.reason: The LED part selection is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, and its level-shifter BOM entry was already established.
The selected LED component and the source Requirement's data-level logic do not change the independent standby power-switching behavior.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the selected LED part number, model, package, and RGBW format.
The addressable LED component and data-level logic do not alter the sensor-board module connectors, buses, or sensor supply requirements.
The source does not change the sensor rail's voltage, loads, enable GPIO, or independent control topology.
The LED selection and level-shifter logic do not change any interboard connector, pinout, or board-distribution requirement.
The source does not affect the standalone USB regulator, its capacity, activation condition, or 3.3V source selection.
Selecting an LED component and retaining its data-level logic does not change which rails are monitored or the monitoring topology.
The source does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or DCDC1 power-path requirements.
The LCSC component selection is consistent with the existing sourcing policy but does not modify that policy or its cost constraints.
The source has no effect on battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The LED component and data-level logic do not alter the power board's dimensions, mounting, connector form, enclosure fit, or layer count.
